item_name: Rothco GI Type Enhanced ''Y'' LC-1 Suspenders
item_short_desc: Rothco GI Type Enhanced ''Y'' LC-1 Suspenders are constructed with a durable enhanced 1000 denier nylon with heavy padding for comfort. The LC-1 Suspenders feature metal clips that attach to military field equipment belts and butt packs. Rothco's Enhanced Military Collection, is better than Mil-Spec with top quality craftsmanship, detailed construction and tough 1000 denier nylon materials.
